sentences.en: I was bewildered at the sight of his strange behavior.
sentences.zh: 我看到他那奇怪的行为时感到很困惑。

sentences.en: I was completely bewildered by his sudden change of mood.
sentences.zh: 他的情绪突然改变让我摸不着头脑。

sentences.en: I was bewildered by his behavior in the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 他在餐馆里的行为让我感到迷茫。
